description: This file defines the CartProvider class and related data structures to manage a shopping cart within a Flutter application. It handles adding, removing, clearing, and restoring cart items, persisting data with shared preferences, and notifying listeners of changes.

classes.name: _CartLine
classes.description: A private class representing a single line item in the cart, including serialization to JSON.

classes.name: CartProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages cart items, persisting data with shared preferences, and providing methods to modify and restore the cart.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new item to the cart and notifies listeners.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes an item at the specified index from the cart and notifies listeners.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all items from the cart and notifies listeners.

methods.name: restoreFromMenu
methods.description: Restores cart items from saved preferences, reconstructing CartItem instances from JSON data.

methods.name: _persist
methods.description: Serializes the cart items to JSON and saves to shared preferences.
